goalZh: 会用 need to + 动词和 Don't + 动词提醒别人
canDoZh: 能提醒别人出门前要做什么、别忘了什么,也能听懂这样的提醒

newItems.noteZh: 也写作 seat belt;Put on your seatbelt.(系好安全带。)复合词重音在前。
Thanks for the ride!(谢谢你送我!)也能当动词:ride a bike(骑自行车),过去式 rode;词尾 d 要带声。
No traffic this early!(这么早不堵车!)堵车也可以说 a traffic jam;a 读 /æ/。
Don't worry.(别担心。)o 读 /ɝː/,要卷舌;过去式 worried。
Don't forget…(别忘了……);过去式 forgot;重音在后 for-GET。
复合词重音在前 BOAR-ding pass;oar 美式卷舌;电子登机牌常在手机或邮箱里。
I don't need to print it.(不用打印。)pr 连读,结尾 nt 收住不加元音。
lap + top,重音在前;a 读 /æ/,o 读 /ɑː/。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Good morning, you guys! Put on your seatbelts.
lines.zh: (1 月 4 日凌晨五点,艾米开车送两人去机场)早上好!系好安全带。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Thanks for the ride, Amy. It's so early!
lines.zh: 谢谢你送我们,艾米。这么早!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: No problem. No traffic this early!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: You need to be at the airport two hours early.
lines.zh: 你们得提前两个小时到机场。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Don't worry. We need to be there at 5:15. We have time.
lines.zh: 别担心。我们 5:15 到就行,时间来得及。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: My boarding pass is in my email. I don't need to print it.
lines.zh: 我的登机牌在邮箱里,不用打印。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Good. And Lei, no water in your bag, OK?
lines.zh: 好。还有磊,包里别放水,记住了吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Got it. My laptop, my boarding pass, no water!
lines.zh: (磊在手机上一条条记下来)知道了。电脑,登机牌,不带水!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Perfect. Don't worry, and have fun in LA!
lines.zh: 很好。别担心,在洛杉矶玩得开心!

questions.prompt: 艾米提醒他们要提前多久到机场?
questions.explainZh: You need to be at the airport two hours early.

questions.prompt: 索菲亚为什么不用打印登机牌?
questions.explainZh: My boarding pass is in my email. I don't need to print it.
And Lei, no water in your bag, OK?(电脑是磊自己记下要带的。)

grammar.titleZh: need to + 动词:需要做某事
grammar.bodyZh: need 后面可以跟名词,也可以跟 to + 动词原形:I need a towel.(需要一样东西)/ You need to be at the airport two hours early.(需要做一件事)。否定:I don't need to print it.(不用打印。)问:Do I need to print it?。中国学生常漏掉 to(说成 You need be…),或者在名词前多加 to(说成 I need to a towel),要先看后面是名词还是动词。

examples.text: You need to be at the airport two hours early.
examples.zh: 你们得提前两个小时到机场。

examples.text: I don't need to print it.

grammar.titleZh: Don't + 动词:叫别人别做某事
grammar.bodyZh: 让别人别做某事,用 Don't + 动词原形:Don't forget your boarding pass!(别忘了登机牌!)Don't worry.(别担心。)don't 后面的动词不加 -s、不加 -ing。想客气一点可以加 please,放在句首或句尾都行:Please don't forget. / Don't forget, please.。发音:don't 的 t 在辅音前常常不爆破,Don't forget 听起来像 “don' forget”。
